MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.NAME: Gram
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.ORIGIN:
Odin thrust it into Branstock, and only Sigmund could pull it out.
Odin himself broke it, and Regin forged it anew.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.FORGE_INT:
Deep inside the tomb, a blade broken in two is ringing.
Gram, the sword Odin broke with his own hand.
As Regin did, the two pieces must be forged anew.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.FORGE_SAF: Set the pieces together and slowly forge them anew.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.FORGE_GAM: Test the new blade by striking the anvil.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.FORGE_SUC: The new blade split the anvil in two.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.FORGE_SHA: Gram broke in two once more. This time there is no Regin to forge it anew. Gram is gone.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.NAME: Ganjiang & Moye
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.TAGLI: A male and a female sword, finished after three years by a smith couple who put their hair and nails into the furnace.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.COST: Takes 2 slots · Max HP -6 the first time
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.ORIGI:
The king ordered the swords made within three months.
The couple finished the two blades after three years.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.FORGE:
The iron will not melt. The three-month deadline has long passed.
They say the smith couple put their hair and nails into the furnace.
A pair of swords finished after three years, with three hundred children working the bellows.
Human spirit is lacking. Put something greater into the furnace.
The male and female blades ring with one voice.
The male and female blades melt down together.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.NAME: Kusanagi
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.TAGLI: The sword that gathers the clouds of heaven; the grass-cutting sword.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.COST: Lose HP when a combat in which it was summoned ends · Can be switched to only twice per combat
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.ORIGI:
Susanoo found the sword inside the tail of the eight-headed serpent.
In a wildfire, it cut the grass and opened a way.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.FORGE:
Clouds gather at its tip. Its first name was the sword that gathers the clouds of heaven.
It is the blade Susanoo found inside the tail of Yamata no Orochi.
After it cut the grass in a wildfire, it became the "grass-cutting sword".
Polish it with care, as one tends a sacred treasure.
Carry it back into the wildfire.
The clouds part and the blade grows clear.
An unexplained fever rises. It was once said that Emperor Tenmu's illness was this sword's doing.
As the sword was once moved from the palace to Atsuta Shrine, it is enshrined deep within the tomb.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.STAGE: One of the Three Sacred Treasures
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.NAME: Tyrfing
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.TAGLIN: It never misses and always grants victory.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.COST: From level 3: a curse each of the first 3 times you use it (three evil deeds)
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.ORIGIN:
A sword the dwarves Dvalinn and Durin forged as the price of their lives.
Each time it is drawn, someone dies.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.FORGE_:
A golden hilt, a blade that shines like flame.
The dwarves Dvalinn and Durin made it as the price of their lives.
It never misses and never rusts, but each time it is drawn it must kill someone.
Hone it on the whetstone without drawing it.
Draw the blade, knowing that someone will die.
Iron and stone part like cloth.
Another of the dwarves' curses awakens.
The blade turned on its master. Svafrlami, too, died by this sword. Tyrfing is gone.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.NAME: Dáinsleif
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.TAGL: Dáinn's legacy. A wound it scratches never heals.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.COST: Cannot gain Block while it is your current sword
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.ORIG:
Högni drew this sword.
From that day on, the battle never ends.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.FORG:
Dáinn's legacy, a sword made by the dwarf Dáinn.
When Högni drew it, reconciliation became impossible.
The battle repeats forever.
Even out the edge without leaving the sheath.
The blade remembers a path that never misses.
The sound of an endless battle will not leave your ears.
The blade will not return to its sheath. Dáinsleif is gone.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.NAME: Durandal
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.TAGLI: A sword that holds holy relics and cannot be broken.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.COST: Cannot be switched to at 30% HP or less
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.ORIGI:
From an angel to Charlemagne, from Charlemagne to Roland.
Struck against a rock ten times, it did not take a single nick.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.FORGE:
Inside the golden hilt: a tooth of Saint Peter, the blood of Saint Basil, hair of Saint Denis, a piece of the Virgin Mary's clothing.
The sword Roland struck against a rock ten times without a single nick.
Clean the relics in the hilt one by one.
Strike it against the rock ten times.
Without a single nick, it has grown harder.
Instead of a nick, the rock stays in your hand.
As with Roland, the sword hides away beneath someone's body.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.NAME: Sköfnung
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.TAGLI: The finest sword of the North, home to the souls of twelve berserkers.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.COST: Cannot be used on the first turn of combat
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.ORIGI:
A sword taken from the grave of Hrólf Kraki.
Sunlight must never touch its hilt.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.FORGE:
The sword of Hrólf Kraki, called the best of all swords ever carried in the North.
The souls of the twelve berserkers who guarded the king dwell in it.
Taboo: sunlight must never touch its hilt.
In the shade, wrap the hilt and hone the edge.
Wake the twelve souls and call them into the blade.
Twelve breaths overlap on the blade.
The stone that heals its wounds has slipped into your pack.
Sunlight touched the hilt. The sword that came out of a grave vanishes again.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.NAME: Onimaru
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.TAGLIN: The blade that moved by itself and cut down an oni.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.COST: Sometimes attacks with a random kind in normal combats
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.ORIGIN:
A blade recorded in the Taiheiki.
It cut down a demon without its master's hand.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.FORGE_:
Without its master's hand, the sword moves by itself.
The Taiheiki records that it moved on its own and cut down an oni.
A tachi the Kyōhō Meibutsuchō named the foremost of five.
Let the blade swing once, as it wishes.
Set the blade free to move by itself.
The blade moves faster, on its own.
The blade slips your hand and moves as it pleases.
The blade leaves on its own, hunting oni.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.STAGE3: One of the Five Swords Under Heaven
The Torch of Nuada, the Sword of Light.
All Light fades if another sword is current at the end of your turn

One of the four treasures brought from Findias.
Once drawn from its sheath of death, none escaped it.

The Sword of Light, also called the Torch of Nuada.
One of the four treasures of the Tuatha Dé Danann, brought from the northern city of Findias.
Once drawn from its sheath of death, none escaped it.
Gather light while it rests in the sheath.
Draw it from the sheath in one motion.
A light no one can resist settles on the blade.
Your arm goes numb. You think of Nuada, who lost his arm and gave up the throne.
The light goes out, and the sheath is empty.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.NAME: Caladbolg
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.TAGL: Fergus's sword, which grew vast enough to split the sky and cut the tops off three hills.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.COST: Deals less damage when there is only one enemy
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.ORIG:
The sword of Leite from the fairy mound.
It cut the tops off three hills.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.FORG:
The sword of Leite from the fairy mound. Its name means "hard cleft" or "hard blade".
When Fergus mac Róich raised it to strike, the blade grew vast enough to split the sky.
That blade cut the tops off three hills.
Lower the point and dress the hard blade.
Raise it until it grows vast enough to reach the sky.
The top of a hill has been cut away.
The point stopped before the king. It could not strike what it should have struck.
The blade vanishes beyond the hills.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.FULL_NOTE: [red]The tomb has no room. A sword must be sent back.[/red]
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ACQUIRED_AGAIN: [gold]{Sword}[/gold] has returned to the tomb. Its sleeping cards return with it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SHATTER_RULE: lose the sword (its cards are stored in the tomb)
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.NIBELUNG: A tuft of wool set adrift on the river is cut apart the moment it touches the blade. The sword that slew Fáfnir has returned. ...And the Nibelung Treasure followed it.

The swords already floating at your side make room to welcome a new one.{FullNote}

MAGICSWORDSMAN-TOMB_EPITAPH_EVENT.title: Epitaph of the Sword Grave
In a deep valley you stand before an epitaph carved where swords were buried.
Beneath the wooden plaque, a hilt juts out of the earth.
When you touch it, the tomb at your back hums low.
Pull It Out
Gain a magic sword you do not own.
Wrench It Free
Lose [red]{ForceHpLoss}[/red] HP. Choose one of two magic swords.
Read the Epitaph
Lose [red]{ReadHpLoss}[/red] HP. Give one of your swords a [gold]Safe Upgrade[/gold] (level +1).
Cover It Up
Cover it with earth. Gain [gold]{CoverGold}[/gold] Gold.

You brush the earth aside and a blade appears: [gold]{Sword}[/gold].
{Tagline}
Take It
Bring this sword into the tomb. If there is no room, send one sword back.
Take Them
Offer [red]{MaxHpCost}[/red] Max HP: human spirit is lacking. Bring Ganjiang & Moye into the tomb (2 slots).
Bury It Again
Return the sword to the earth.
You cover the blade with earth. Only the wooden plaque remains.

Ganjiang and Moye take two places in the tomb.
Offer {MaxHpCost} Max HP: human spirit is lacking.
Offer
Lose [red]{MaxHpCost}[/red] Max HP and take Ganjiang & Moye.
Give Up
Return the swords to the earth.
In the end, the hilt slipped from your hands.

You read the epitaph to the end. The sword at your side answers it.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold]: level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
You cover the hilt with earth. A few gold coins come up on your fingertips.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TOMB_RESONANCE_EVENT.page:
Before you set out, the tomb behind you hums low.
The first blade to wake for this journey: [gold]{FirstSword}[/gold].
One more blade may come along beside it.
The light of three blades leaks through the gate.{FullNote}
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.EFFECT: Attacks deal extra damage equal to the upgrade level.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.EFFEC: Ganjiang: more attack damage / Moye: more Block. Alternate them for [Pair] bonuses.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.EFFEC: Inherits half of the previous sword's effect.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.EFFE: Played cards return to the draw pile instead of the discard pile.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.EFFEC: Attack damage you take is reduced.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.EFFEC: Attacks pile Scars on enemies. 12 Scars burst.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.EFFECT: Attacks on its own every turn. Stance cards change how.
Ending your turn with it charges Light. Unleash it with Draw-cut cards.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.STYL: Replay the same cards again and again
Charge Light, release it at once
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.POPUP_HEADER: A new cursed blade awakens in the tomb
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TOMB_RESONANCE_EVENT.page:

Go Back

MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_MASTERY.TIP:
The first time this sword reaches [gold]level 5[/gold], its legend card [gold]{Card}[/gold] is added to your deck. Once per run.
{Line}
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_MASTERY.FORGE_RESUL:
{Line}
[gold]The sword is complete[/gold] — legend card "{Card}" added to your deck.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_MASTERY.POPUP_REWAR: Added to your deck. It is one of this sword's cards, so it already fights at level 5.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GRAM.MASTERY: A tuft of wool drifting down the river parts on the edge by itself. The blade that slew Fafnir has returned.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.GANJIANG.MASTE: After three hundred children worked the bellows, the male and female blades are finished at last, in three years.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.KUSANAGI.MASTE: With the mirror and the jewel, one of the Three Sacred Treasures that pass with the throne.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.TYRFING.MASTER: It never misses, never rusts, cuts iron and stone like cloth, and always gives victory to its bearer.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DAINSLEIF.MAST: It never misses, and no wound it scratches ever heals. The battle repeats forever.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.DURANDAL.MASTE: Ten blows against the rock, and not a scratch.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.SKOFNUNG.MASTE: The souls of all twelve berserkers who guarded the king now dwell in the blade.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.ONIMARU.MASTER: The tachi the Kyōhō Meibutsuchō named first among the five.
Drawn from its sheath of death, none escape it and none can resist it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.CALADBOLG.MAST: Raised to strike, it grows as wide as a rainbow and shears the tops off three hills.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-FAFNIRS_HEART_EVENT.title: Fafnir's Heart
MAGICSWORDSMAN-FAFNIRS_HEART_EVENT.pages:
Dragon's blood runs down over the pit. Gram has pierced Fafnir's heart.
Regin asked for the heart to be roasted. Sigurd, touching it to see if it was done, burned his finger, put it in his mouth, and so the tale goes, understood the birds.
"Regin will betray you. Eat the heart yourself."
Deeper in the lair lies the gold the dragon guarded.
Lose [red]{TasteHpLoss}[/red] HP. Upgrade [gold]Gram[/gold] by 1 level. (Not at level 5.)
Add the card [gold]Fafnir's Heart[/gold] to your deck.

Gain [gold]{HoardGold}[/gold] Gold. Obtain the curse [red]Nibelung Treasure[/red].
The treasure will not follow again when Gram reaches level 5.

As the dragon's blood touches your tongue, birdsong turns into words. The blade answers them.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
You eat the heart. The dragon's strength smoulders slowly inside you.
You load the gold onto the cart. This hoard, they say, destroyed two royal houses.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-BARROW_FIRES_EVENT.title: The Barrow Fires of Samsø
Fire flickers between the barrows of Samsø. The sons of the berserker Arngrim lie buried here.
Hervor, Angantyr's daughter, is said to have walked through these fires and called her father up from his grave. She asked for one thing only: Tyrfing, buried with him.
The dead man warned her that the sword would destroy her whole line.
Obtain [gold]Tyrfing[/gold]. If Mangeomchong is full, release a sword first. Then lose [red]{FireHpLoss}[/red] HP to the barrow fires.
Leave the sword in the grave. Remove a card from your deck.
The golden hilt is in your hand; the blade shines like flame. Behind you, the barrow fire scorches your cloak.
You turn your back on the barrow. Your step is lighter by what you left behind.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-HOGNIS_ANSWER_EVENT.title: Högni's Answer
MAGICSWORDSMAN-HOGNIS_ANSWER_EVENT.pages:
Heðinn has carried off Hildr, Högni's daughter, and Högni has followed him to the island.
Heðinn offers much gold as atonement. Högni's answer, the story goes, was this:
"Too late. I have already drawn Dáinsleif. The dwarves made it: it must kill a man each time it is drawn, it never misses, and its wounds never heal."
At night Hildr wakes all the fallen. The battle begins again.
Upgrade [gold]Dáinsleif[/gold] by 1 level. Obtain the curse [red]Irreconcilable[/red]. (Not at level 5.)
Gain [gold]{RansomGold}[/gold] Gold. [gold]Dáinsleif[/gold] loses 1 level (nothing at level 0).
Lose [red]{HildMaxHpLoss}[/red] Max HP. Heal to full.

The sword will not go back into its sheath. Words of peace are lost under the ring of the blade.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.

You take the gold. Denied its blood, the sword growls low in its sheath.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
All night someone tends your wounds. You wake whole, yet with a little less of yourself.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-RONCEVAUX_EVENT.title: Roncevaux
MAGICSWORDSMAN-RONCEVAUX_EVENT.pages.INI:
The narrow pass of Roncevaux. The rearguard is already surrounded.
Three times Oliver begged Roland to sound the Olifant, and three times he refused. When at last he blew it, they say, he blew until his temples burst.
Dying, Roland struck Durendal against the rock so no enemy would take it. The blade did not take a scratch.
Lose [red]{HornHpLoss}[/red] HP. Add the card [gold]Olifant[/gold] to your deck.
Upgrade [gold]Durandal[/gold] by 1 level. Obtain the curse [red]Roland's Rock[/red]. (Not at level 5.)
Rest with the sword and horn beneath you. Heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-RONCEVAUX_EVENT.pages.HOR: The horn's call rolls far beyond the pass. You taste blood.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-RONCEVAUX_EVENT.pages.ROC:
Ten blows. The rock splits; the blade only grows harder. The weight of the rock stays in your aching hands.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-RONCEVAUX_EVENT.pages.RES: You close your eyes with the sword beneath you, where no enemy can take it. The strength to rise returns.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-WILDFIRE_EVENT.title: Wildfire
MAGICSWORDSMAN-WILDFIRE_EVENT.pages.INIT:
In the middle of the field, fire leaps up on every side. Whoever lured you here has set the grass alight.
Yamato Takeru was trapped like this, the tale says. He cut the grass away with the sword his aunt Yamatohime had given him, and lit a counter-fire with the flint from the bag she gave him with it.
From that day the Sword of the Gathering Clouds was called Kusanagi, the Grass-Cutter.
Lose [red]{CutHpLoss}[/red] HP. Upgrade [gold]Kusanagi[/gold] by 1 level. (Not at level 5.)
Remove a card from your deck.
You swing through the smoke. Where the grass falls, a path opens. The blade drinks in the firelight.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-WILDFIRE_EVENT.pages.COUN: The counter-fire swallows the wildfire. Nothing useless is left where it passed.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-TOKIMASAS_DREAM_EVENT.pag:
Every night a small oni comes into the sleeper's dreams to torment him.
According to the Taiheiki, Hōjō Tokimasa fell ill this way. An old man came to him in a dream, saying he was the sword: "Rust holds me in my scabbard. Clean it off, and I will drive the oni away."
Once cleaned and left standing unsheathed, the sword fell of its own accord and cut the head off the oni carved on a brazier stand, so the story goes.
Pay [gold]{PolishGold}[/gold] Gold. Upgrade [gold]Onimaru[/gold] by 1 level. (Not at level 5.)
Remove a [red]Curse[/red] from your deck. (Needs a removable curse.)

Rust flakes away under the whetstone. That night, no oni came into your dreams.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
At midnight you wake to the sound of the sword falling on its own. One of the curses you carry lies cut in two.
You wrestle the oni all night. By morning you are worn out, but tougher than before.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SUMMON.T0: You again. A boy swinging a broken blade.
Broken or not, it still cuts.
Sigurd's hands never shook like this.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.COMBATSTA: Draw me. The tomb is dull.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.VICTORY.T: Hmph. Not a dragon among them.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.REST.T0.0: Don't doze by the fire. The careless die first.
If you fall, let go of me first.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SUMMON.T1: You're late. Call me first next time.
Fine. You get the first cut.
Loosen your wrist. I'll do the cutting.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.COMBATSTA: I smell it. A tough one today.
That's why I woke you first.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.REST.T1.0: If you're cleaning me, start with the edge.
I know. You say it every time.
Don't back down. One broken thing is enough.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.UPGRADE.T: The seam is gone. Not bad.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SUMMON.T2: Ensifer, eyes forward. I've got your back.
Good. Your hands are steady today.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.COMBATSTA: Draw me first. The first cut should be heavy.
I know. I'm counting on that weight.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.VICTORY.T: See that? We cut that down.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.REST.T2.0: Sigurd cleaned his blade by a fire like this.
Get up! You don't end here.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.UPGRADE.T: Feels like the days I split the anvil.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SUMMON.T3: Your grip suits me better than Sigurd's. Surprisingly.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.COMBATSTA: Broken things get reforged. Both of us.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.VICTORY.T: Better than the day I slew Fafnir.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.REST.T3.0: Ensifer. If every other blade leaves, I stay.
I know. You're the blade that comes back even when it breaks.
I'm here. You won't fall alone.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.UPGRADE.T: I'll remember this flame. You forged it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.SUMMO: Where is Moye? Bring her out first.
I'll bring you both.
I'm here. Don't make a fuss.
I'd rather melt than serve a king again.
I'm not a king.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.COMBA: 'Make it in three months,' they said. Humans always rush.
Not as hot as a furnace.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.LOWHP: Pathetic. Will you fall in front of Moye?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.UPGRA: Hair and nails went into this steel. Don't hammer it carelessly.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.SUMMO: Ah, it's you. Moye, he looks better today.
He does. His hands shake less.
I cut. Leave the guarding to Moye.
Got it. Teamwork.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.COMBA: I smell fire. A fight is near.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.VICTO: Did you see, Moye? I struck first.
I miss the sound of three hundred children at the bellows.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.LOWHP: Fall back! Moye and I will hold.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.SUMMO: Ensifer, look after Moye. I'll open the way.
Leave it to me.
You've learned how to wield us both, haven't you?
Alternate, right?
Go on, tell us.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.VICTO: A good fight. You helped, too.
The couple who made us used to sit by a fire like this.
They always held hands by the fire.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.LOWHP: Hold on. Our makers held on for three years.
Next to three years, a few turns is nothing.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.UPGRA: Moye and I grow stronger together.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.SUMMO: You're like a son to us.
...That's a little embarrassing.
I'll cut anything. The three of us are enough.
Yeah. Three's enough.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.VICTO: Ha! More satisfying than a king's neck.
Ensifer, sleep before the fire dies. We'll keep watch.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.LOWHP: I'd go back into the furnace before I lose you!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.UPGRA: What took three years, you've done.
Because you two waited for me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SUMMON.T0: Handle me gently. I'm not as sturdy as he is.
Are you the new master? You're so young.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.REST.T0.0: The firelight is warm. The furnace always hurt.
I'll guard you. Get behind me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.UPGRADE.T: I'm a little sturdier now. Thank you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SUMMON.T1: We meet again. You look brighter today.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.COMBATSTA: Breathe first. No need to rush.
You're pale. I'll guard, so catch your breath.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SUMMON.T2: Call and I'll always come. You know that?
Ganjiang, he's become quite dependable, hasn't he?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.COMBATSTA: Let's all three come home today.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.REST.T2.0: Our makers used to laugh like this, too.
No, not yet. I'm right here.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.UPGRADE.T: It feels like being reborn in your hands.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SUMMON.T3: Stop it, both of you. It's embarrassing.
I'll go anywhere with you. Even into fire.
I'm not taking you into fire.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.COMBATSTA: Don't get hurt. Promise me that much.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.REST.T3.0: Ensifer, someday hold something other than swords. Flowers, maybe.
I'm your shield. To the very end.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.UPGRADE.T: Now I can stand beside Ganjiang with pride.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.SUMMO: You summon a sacred regalia so lightly.
I called because I need you.
Twice. No more than that.
I know. I'll use them wisely.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.COMBA: The clouds hang heavy. Something impure draws near.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.VICTO: The filth is cleared. Wash yourself as well.
The night I cut the burning grass was this quiet, too.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.LOWHP: What a sight. Susanoo would have laughed.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.UPGRA: Not hands fit for a regalia... but earnest ones.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.SUMMO: You seek me again. I don't mind.
Good to hear.
I'll carry on half the strength of the last blade.
Thanks, Kusanagi.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.COMBA: The wind has turned. Time to take up the blade.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.VICTO: Clean. Your swordwork too, a little.
When the clouds part, the stars appear. Rest.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.LOWHP: Impurity has seeped into you. I'll draw it out.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.UPGRA: Clouds gather at my tip. Not bad.
Closer to how you used to be?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.SUMMO: Call me. For you, two times are no waste.
Thanks for saying that.
Ensifer, today the wind is on your side.
And so are you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.COMBA: The clouds of heaven gather for you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.VICTO: Well cut. I'd boast of it to Susanoo.
Even a regalia tires. Keep me close tonight.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.LOWHP: Don't retreat. I'll cut a path, as I did through the fire.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.SUMMO: The pact of two... with you alone, I wish it were more.
Two is enough. You never miss.
You're no master a regalia would serve. But as a friend, you'll do.
A friend is enough.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.COMBA: Ensifer. Let us cut a path together again.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.VICTO: Heh. The sky is clear. Thanks to you.
I'm more at ease beside you than my old masters. Strange.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.LOWHP: Let me cleanse you. Don't fall, my friend.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.UPGRA: This blade, I offer to you.
Don't offer it. Just come with me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.SUMMON: You drew me. Now someone dies.
That's why I drew you.
Everyone who held my golden hilt ended badly. So will you.
We'll see.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.VICTOR: You won. I always grant victory. The price comes later.
Die now and the curse ends with you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.UPGRAD: The sharper I get, the deeper the curse. Still want this?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.SUMMON: Again? You've no fear.
I'm scared. I still have to.
I never miss. My only virtue.
That's all I need.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.COMBAT: Dvalin's curse is restless today. Be careful.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.REST.T: A blade that never rusts never learns to rest.
Then I'll rest for both of us.
Fool. How would it look if my wielder died first?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.UPGRAD: My flame-edge burns again. ...I won't thank you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.SUMMON: Ensifer. I'll bear the curse. You just cut.
Let's split it.
Not even Angantyr cared for me like you do.
It's not care. It's trust.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.COMBAT: Draw me if you need to. Better than dying while you hesitate.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.VICTOR: Another win. This time... I'll pay the price.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.REST.T: You sleep soundly beside a cursed blade.
No. You are not the one who dies this time.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.UPGRAD: Back to the days I cut iron and stone. Let it serve something good this time.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.SUMMON: I'll carry the three evil deeds. You stay clean.
I said we'd carry them together.
I always grant victory. This time, I mean it.
I'll take it, gladly.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.COMBAT: Ensifer. You may draw me. You, of all people.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.VICTOR: Only the enemy died. For once, the curse missed.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.REST.T: Not even Dvalin could have imagined a master like you.
I never imagined a blade like you, either.
Curse, hear me. Not him. Never him.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.UPGRAD: I'll be the blade that always wins. For you alone.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.SUMM: Blood! You finally let me out!
Easy.
Once drawn, I don't go back until I taste blood.
I know. That's why I drew carefully.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.COMB: A fight! A fight that never ends!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.REST: I hate resting. Högni fought all night.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.LOWH: I'd rather not taste your blood... yet.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.SUMM: I've been waiting. Who do we cut today?
Those ones over there.
Drop the shield. You only need me.
That's your price, I know.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.COMB: I hear heartbeats. Yours, and theirs.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.VICT: Heh, that was good. Let's fight longer next time.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.REST: The sheath is stifling. Let me stay out a bit.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.LOWH: Hurt? Then we pay them back in blood.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.UPGR: Now the wounds I leave will run even deeper.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.SUMM: Ensifer! Fighting with you is the best.
That's a little scary.
Don't worry. I won't drink your blood. Promise.
Thanks. You mean it?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.COMB: Even an endless battle isn't bad with you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.REST: Strange. These days, the sheath isn't so bad.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.LOWH: Who made you bleed? I'll cut them all.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.UPGR: When you forge me, I feel less thirsty.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.SUMM: When you call, I come faster than to the smell of blood.
That's a compliment, right?
I like you better than Högni. He never cared for me.
I will.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.COMB: I'll end this fight too. For you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.VICT: I like your praise more than blood. Say it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.REST: I'll go back in the sheath tonight. No blood needed.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.UPGR: Even an endless battle is fine, if it's with you.
Let's make it one that ends.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.SUMMO: You called. This blade is swung for faith.
I'll swing it to protect.
Roland struck me on stone ten times and could not break me.
I don't plan to try.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.COMBA: The relics in my hilt tremble. Evil is near.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.VICTO: Thanks be to God. And to you, a little.
I will pray. For you as well.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.LOWHP: You cannot take me up now. But I will pray beside you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.UPGRA: You'd lay hands on an unblemished blade? ...I feel your care, at least.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.SUMMO: We meet again, young warden.
Good to see you, Durandal.
Stand behind me. Guarding is my duty.
I'm counting on you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.COMBA: I think of Charlemagne's banners. March proudly.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.VICTO: Well fought. Roland would have praised you.
Before a fire, all are equal. Saints and wardens alike.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.LOWHP: Step back and breathe. You'll hold me again soon.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.UPGRA: The relics grow warm. A blessed hammering.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.SUMMO: Guarding you is now my faith.
That's a heavy thing to say.
I'm not the only unbreakable one. So are you.
...Thanks, Durandal.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.COMBA: The prayers are done. Now we fight together.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.VICTO: You never once fell back. I'm proud.
At the end, Roland tried to break me so no enemy would have me.
I'll make sure it never comes to that.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.LOWHP: You're where I cannot reach. Please, come back.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.UPGRA: The unblemished blade is yours now.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.SUMMO: My friend, today again I stand before you.
Thank you, always.
I think I finally know why the angel gave me to the world.
Why?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.COMBA: No evil will touch you. Not while I stand.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.VICTO: To God, and to you. This time, equal thanks.
There is no holier duty than guarding your sleep.
Then I'll leave it to you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.LOWHP: Even if you can't hold me, I'm here. To the end.
I know. I can feel it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.UPGRA: I'd rather be called Ensifer's sword than Roland's.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.SUMMO: The twelve of us are watching. Don't disappoint.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.COMBA: Let no sunlight touch the hilt. Wait before the first cut.
Fire is good. Sun is not.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.LOWHP: You bleed. A berserker would laugh.
I'm not in a laughing mood.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.UPGRA: The twelve souls murmur. They watched your hammering.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.SUMMO: About three of the twelve have started to approve of you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.COMBA: Smells of a grave. Not ours. Theirs.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.VICTO: The twelve roar as one. A good fight!
King Hrólf held his feasts by a fire like this.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.LOWHP: Rise! The king's berserkers never knelt!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.UPGRA: My edge remembers the northern cold again.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.SUMMO: All twelve want to call you king. ...I refused.
Good. I don't want to be king.
Our souls brace your back. Don't be afraid.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.COMBA: As one waits for sunset, wait out the first turn. Then it's our turn.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.VICTO: The twelve chant your name. Ensifer!
The barrow was cold and quiet. Beside you, it's loud and warm.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.LOWHP: We'll guard you as we guarded the king. All twelve!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.UPGRA: Thanks to you, we reclaim the name 'finest blade of the North.'
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.SUMMO: The twelve speak as one. You are our thirteenth.
First time since King Hrólf that we're glad to be drawn.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.COMBA: Let the sun come. You'll be our shade.
We needn't return to the king's barrow. Our place is here.
Stay as long as you like.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.LOWHP: Not one of the thirteen falls!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.UPGRA: In the name of the twelve berserkers, this blade is yours.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.COMBAT: I need no master. I cut alone.
I know. Let's stay together anyway.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.VICTOR: I only cut what needed cutting.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.REST.T: You don't have to talk. Let's rest.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.COMBAT: Give the order. I may listen.
I'm okay. I can still hold.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.COMBAT: I've found a reason to move on my own. You.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.VICTOR: They called me first of the five. Today it was true.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.REST.T: I learned from you that a fire is warm.
Whatever lays a hand on you, oni or man, I cut.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.UPGRAD: Did you just say thank you?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.COMBAT: I said I need no master. ...You're the exception.
I come even if you don't call. Always.
I know. That's why I feel safe.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.REST.T: I'll stay till you sleep. And after.
Don't fall back. This time I'll be your hand.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.UPGRAD: Sharper now. Sharp enough to protect you.
You kept me in the dark so long. Dazzling, aren't I?
A little.
Hold another blade at turn's end and my light goes out. Remember.
I'll remember.
So dark. If not now, when will you call me?
When the time comes.
Nothing stands before the light.
Yeah. Blinding.
A campfire... a candle, next to me.
This one's warmer.
Once I'm drawn, no one escapes. So why are you the one losing?
I haven't lost yet.
Brighter! Worthy of Nuada's torch!
My eyes hurt.
I gathered light while I waited. You may praise me.
Good job.
End your turn holding me. That's how the light builds.
Okay, promise.
Time to show them the light of Findias.
Looking forward to it.
Hm, my light was rather beautiful today, wasn't it?
Yeah, it was.
At night, even I dim a little. It's a secret.
I'll keep it.
Don't close your eyes. You need to see my light.
I see it. I still see it.
Stars flew from your hammer. I like it.
I'm glad.
Ensifer, my light shines brightest in your hand.
That's nice to hear.
Switch to the others if you like. Just come back to me at the end.
I'll always come back.
However deep the dark, it's daytime when we're together.
Nice line.
Shining with you, I was twice as bright.
I don't shine, though.
Your face in the firelight isn't bad.
Where'd that come from?
Spend all my light if you must. Just get up.
Save it. I'm getting up.
Not even Nuada polished me this carefully.
So I win.
Just hearing you call me makes me shine.
Same when I see you.
The light no one escapes is now the light that guards you.
Thank you, Solais.
Let's go, Ensifer. Dazzling, as always.
Yeah. Dazzling.
See? Together, we turn night to day.
Yeah, I saw.
Tonight I'll be your light instead of the fire. Sleep well.
Thanks. Not too bright, though.
Don't go out! Stay where my light reaches!
...I'm here. I won't.
Now I know. You're the reason I shine.
That's a little embarrassing.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.SUMM: Ha! Cramped! No room to swing!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.COMB: I'm the blade that cut three hills. These are nothing.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.REST: The fires on the fairy mound were bigger.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.LOWH: Hey, if you fall, who'll carry me?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.UPGR: Bigger! Big enough to split the sky!
Then you won't fit in the Tomb.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.SUMM: Here we go! How many today?
Up to three in one swing. More, two swings!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.VICT: Refreshing! This is why we fight!
You look happiest in a fight.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.REST: Resting's not bad. Big swings need big rests.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.LOWH: Back off! I'll take one big swing!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.UPGR: My blade's harder! Leite would be amazed.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.SUMM: Ensifer! For you, I'd cut ten hills!
Even one foe is fine. Fighting with you is fun.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.VICT: Ha! Your hands have gotten used to my size!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.REST: I like it here better than the fairy mound. The only loud one is me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.LOWH: How dare they! Let's sweep them all away!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.UPGR: This time I might really split the sky!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.SUMM: You can call me big brother! ...No, let's be friends.
I'm more excited today than the day I cut three hills!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.COMB: However many there are, I'll clear your path.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.REST: I'll keep quiet tonight. Just while you sleep.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.LOWH: Whoever knocks you down, I'll blast them along with the hill!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.UPGR: The sky-splitting blade, I leave in your hands!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SKEGGIS_WARNING_EVENT.pag:
Old Skeggi holds out a sword: Sköfnung, taken from the grave of King Hrólf Kraki. Twelve berserkers are said to have stood at that king's side.
As he handed it over, Skeggi warned again and again, so the tale goes:
"Never draw it where a woman is present. Never let the sun shine on its hilt. If a little snake creeps out from under the hilt, tilt the sword and let it creep back."
"A wound this sword makes will not heal unless it is rubbed with the Sköfnung stone."
Upgrade [gold]Sköfnung[/gold] by 1 level. Obtain the curse [red]Sköfnung Stone[/red]. (Not at level 5.)
Lose [red]{ChampionsHpLoss}[/red] HP. Add the card [gold]Hrólf's Champions[/gold] to your deck.
Rub the Wound with the Stone

You draw the sword in the shade. A little snake slips out from under the hilt, then quietly back. You tie the stone to your belt; from now on it goes wherever the sword goes.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
As you draw it, the blade howls like the war cry of the men who once guarded a king. It has cut your palm.
You rub the stone over the cut the sword gave you. Slowly, the open wound closes.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYES_HAIR_EVENT.title: Moye's Hair
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYES_HAIR_EVENT.pages.IN:
The furnace roars, yet the iron will not melt.
Moye, wife of the smith Ganjiang, is said to have cut off her hair and nails and thrown them into the fire. When the children worked the bellows, the iron melted at last, and the couple gave the two swords their own names.
Another tale is told as well. Ganjiang gave the king only the female sword, hid the male one, and was put to death for it. Years later his son Chi found the sword, and gave a stranger his own head and the sword so that the stranger would avenge him.
Lose [red]{HairMaxHpLoss}[/red] Max HP. Upgrade [gold]Ganjiang & Moye[/gold] by 1 level. (Not at level 5.)
Add the card [gold]Hidden Blade[/gold] to your deck.
Lose [red]{VengeanceHpLoss}[/red] HP. Add the card [gold]Vengeance[/gold] to your deck.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYES_HAIR_EVENT.pages.HA:
Hair and nails flare up in the fire, and only then does the molten iron run. Something of you has gone into the blade.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYES_HAIR_EVENT.pages.HI: You show one sword and hide the other deep. The day to draw it will come.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-MOYES_HAIR_EVENT.pages.VE: The price was not light. In return, the sword will not forget its enemy's neck.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SILVER_ARM_EVENT.title: The Silver Arm
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SILVER_ARM_EVENT.pages.IN:
The sword of Nuada, brought from Findias. Once it was drawn from its sheath, they say, no one escaped it.
Yet Nuada lost his arm fighting the Fir Bolg. A blemished man could not be king, so he gave up the throne.
Dian Cécht the physician, with Credne the smith, made him an arm of silver that moved like a living one, so the story goes.
Pay [gold]{SilverGold}[/gold] Gold. Upgrade [gold]Claíomh Solais[/gold] by 1 level. (Not at level 5.)
Add the card [gold]Silver Arm[/gold] to your deck. Obtain the curse [red]Nuada's Lost Arm[/red].
Lose [red]{ThroneMaxHpLoss}[/red] Max HP. Remove a card from your deck.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SILVER_ARM_EVENT.pages.SI:
Silver fingers close around the hilt. The blade's light burns brighter.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SILVER_ARM_EVENT.pages.AR: The silver arm moves as it should, but the empty place of the lost one remains.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SILVER_ARM_EVENT.pages.TH: You set down one thing you were holding. You are a little lighter, and a little weaker.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-THREE_HILLS_EVENT.title: Three Hills
MAGICSWORDSMAN-THREE_HILLS_EVENT.pages.I:
The last battle of the Cattle Raid of Cooley. Fergus, exiled from Ulster, fought for Connacht with Caladbolg in hand.
When he struck at his old king Conchobar, the king's shield Ochain screamed, and all the shields of Ulster screamed with it, so the tale goes.
Cormac, the king's son, begged him to spare his king. Fergus turned his blade aside and cut the tops off three hills.
And when Cú Chulainn came, Fergus kept his old promise and led his men from the field.
Upgrade [gold]Caladbolg[/gold] by 1 level. Obtain the curse [red]Shield of the Unstruck King[/red]. (Not at level 5.)
Lose [red]{OchainHpLoss}[/red] HP. Add the card [gold]Intimidate[/gold] to your deck.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-THREE_HILLS_EVENT.pages.H:
The blade grows as if to touch the sky, and the hilltops fall away. The shield of the king you never struck still floats before your eyes.
[gold]{Sword}[/gold] — level {NewLevel}, {Stage}.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-THREE_HILLS_EVENT.pages.O: The shield screams, and every shield around it answers. Your ears ring. You keep that sound in the blade.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-THREE_HILLS_EVENT.pages.W: You sheathe your sword and turn from the field. Behind you, the tide of battle turns.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_LORE.POPUP_HEADER_F: The first blade to wake in the tomb for this journey
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SUMMON.T0: Grip me properly this time. Don't fumble.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SUMMON.T1: If you called me, don't hesitate.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SUMMON.T2: I'm here. Where do we start?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SUMMON.T3: I hear your call from the far end of the tomb.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.COMBATSTA: Another fight. Don't wake me for small fry.
Mind your footing. That's half of it.
Breathe. You already know how to win.
Ensifer, I'll be your blade again today.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.VICTORY.T: You got lucky. Don't count on it twice.
Our edges agreed. We looked the same way.
I can tell with a glance now.
I doubt he'd have praised us.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.REST.T0.1: Don't stare at my seam. It's a shameful scar.
It's a medal, not a scar.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.REST.T1.1: Sometimes I still smell Fafnir's blood.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.REST.T2.1: Sigurd rested with his blade on his knees. Like you.
Bleeding is fine. Letting go isn't.
I broke once too. Still here.
Ensifer! Hold my grip tight. We go to the end together.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.UPGRADE.T: Rough hammering. The steel held, though.
Where Odin broke me aches less.
A broken blade came this far. Your doing.
Now I could split a mountain, not just an anvil.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SWITCH.T0: The others weren't enough, I see.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SWITCH.T2: Good. I'll take it from here.
Of course the finish is mine.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.ELITESTAR: A little. That's why you're here.
A strong one. Sigurd liked those.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.BOSSSTART: That feels like a dragon. Or something as big.
Nothing like it since Fafnir. Ready, Ensifer?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.BOSSVICTO: You felled it. ...Fine, I'll grant you that.
The dragon-slaying blade felled another giant. Remember it.
I'll carve it on the tomb.
Not a scratch. They were weak.
Not a nick on you. Cleaner than Sigurd.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.CURSED.T0: That curse isn't my fault. ...Half of it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.CURSED.T2: Gold always brings a curse. I'm sorry.
It's fine. We'll carry it together.
Giving me up? ...Hmph. I'll survive anywhere.
I came back once, broken. I'll come back again.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.REACQUIRE: So you came back for me.
I missed the smell of the tomb. I'm back.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.SHOP.T0.0: Don't even look at cheap blades.
Sigurd found a ring in a place like this. And regretted it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.IDLE.T0.0: Why dawdle? The enemy won't wait.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GRAM.IDLE.T2.0: Think long, cut short. Now cut.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.SUMMON: Every time I'm drawn, someone dies. Who this time?
Them.
Mind your hands. My edge is fire.
I'm wearing gloves.
You again. Odd. I'm glad now.
I'm glad too.
In your hand, even the curse keeps quiet.
Then I'll keep holding you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.COMBAT: Victory, I promise. Don't ask the price.
The smell of blood is thick today. Be careful.
All you ever do is warn me.
You've already chosen who meets my edge.
This fight's curse falls on them.
Good. Let's keep it that way.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.VICTOR: I'll decide how to pay it.
Not one miss. I told you.
You still smile after winning. The curse has nowhere to go.
If Dvalin saw this, he might take back the curse.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.REST.T: Fall asleep and Angantyr visits your dreams. Beware.
Hervor pulled me out of a grave. You put me in one.
My golden hilt in the firelight—pretty? ...Forget I said that.
While you sleep, I'll hold the curse back.
See? I said my bearers end badly.
Don't die. You'll mess up the curse's order.
My curse won't take you. Never.
If the blade of victory loses you, what victory is that?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.UPGRAD: Stronger now. So is the curse's hunger.
Your hands are gentler than Dvalin's hammer.
This edge burns only for you now.
I'll use that fire with care.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.SWITCH: You took me after all. No regrets.
I know. That's why it's you.
I'll take the blood. Keep your hands clean.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.ELITES: For that one, even my curse is well spent.
A strong foe. Don't hesitate to draw me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.BOSSST: Tougher than Angantyr. Still, it dies in the end.
Ensifer. Today I pour the whole curse into that thing.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.BOSSVI: Even the giant fell. I always bring victory.
No price for this one. I decided so.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.FLAWLE: Won without a scratch. The curse is embarrassed.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.CURSED: I warned you. One of the three evil deeds.
I knew when I took you.
...I'm sorry. This part isn't mine to control.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.RELEAS: I'll go. I'm taking the curse with me. Travel light.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.REACQU: Back for me? Missed the curse?
I'm back. Don't let go so easily this time.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.SHOP.T: That merchant smells gold. He's eyeing my hilt.
Nothing here to lift a curse. ...Never mind.
Places like this always hide a price. Like me.
Think of the ending before you choose. I didn't, and became a curse.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.TYRFING.IDLE.T: Don't stand there idle with a drawn blade.
What are you weighing? I never miss anyway.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.SUMM: I'm out! Blood—where's the blood?
Over there. Go easy.
How many today? The more the better!
The fewer the better.
Thanks for calling! Let's play again!
Fighting isn't playing.
I followed your scent. Better than blood.
...That's a weird compliment.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.COMB: What do they taste like? I wanna know!
Högni always smiled before a fight. You too!
A fight! But I'll pace myself, since I'm with you.
Whoever hurts you dies first. Decided.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.VICT: I'm full today. Because you fought well.
We won! Praise me now. Quick!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.REST: Boring. I'd rather watch a fight than a fire.
The Hjaðningar rose again every night. Will we?
Tonight I'll dream of you, not blood.
My sheath feels warm. Must be because you clean me every day.
Then I'll clean you tonight too.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.LOWH: You smell of blood... no, I have to hold back.
Don't bleed so much. It gets me excited.
Who? Who did that? I'll hunt that one to the end.
Ensifer, stay with me! I don't want a fight without you!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.UPGR: Whoa, sharper! I wanna try it now!
The hammer sounds like a heartbeat. Nice.
My edge gleams. I can see your face in it.
I wish it were smiling more.
Even this sharp, I'll never cut you. Promise.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.SWIT: Finally! I was itching for it!
Leave it to me. I'll finish it clean.
I love it best when we swing together.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.ELIT: A strong one. A long fight! Ah—I'll keep it short.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.BOSS: Never seen one so big! We could fight forever!
Scared, Ensifer? It's fine. I'll charge in first.
The big one fell! Aw, over so soon!
I'm glad this one ended. Weird, right?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.FLAW: You didn't bleed a drop? Tch... I mean, good job.
Not a scratch! That's my master!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.CURS: No reconciliation. That's my curse. Hehe.
Sorry... I'm just that kind of sword.
I know. I'm keeping you anyway.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.RELE: What, you're dumping me? I'll go find another fight!
I hate this... but if you decided, I'll go. Call me again.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.REAC: I'm back! Take me where the blood is!
You called me back! I waited. So long.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.SHOP: Buy me a whetstone! The roughest one!
Browsing is fun. Second only to fighting.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.EVEN: Is there a fight here? No? Boring.
Whatever you pick, I'll follow. No blood needed.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DAINSLEIF.IDLE: Why are you just standing there? Cut! Now!
Sleepy? A little poke would wake you. Kidding.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.SUMMO: I come forth in the name of the relics. Do not act rashly.
I'll be careful.
May the Lord's grace be with you. And I as well.
Having both is reassuring.
Call, and I will be your shield.
A sword as a shield?
My friend, I am glad to stand with you again.
Me too.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.COMBA: Pray first. The blade comes after.
Roland would not sound his horn. You, ask for help.
I'll call if I need it.
Evil does not retreat. Neither shall we.
Beside you, I'd not fear Roncevaux.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.VICTO: Victory belongs to the Lord. Do not be proud.
You're unharmed. That is my victory.
Then this was a full win.
Even Charlemagne's court had few knights like you.
Do not forget your prayers before sleep.
My hilt holds a saint's tooth and blood. Perhaps that's why nights are calm.
Thanks for keeping us today. To the Lord, and to you.
Roland never let go of me. Nor will you, I think.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.LOWHP: Your wounds are deep. Perhaps the price of pride.
Lord, protect this one. With my share too.
I hope that prayer was heard.
I do not break. Neither must you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.UPGRA: You left the relics alone. Good.
The blade rings clear. Like a hymn.
Your care is engraved on my edge.
It is as if an angel forged me anew.
An angel is a bit much.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.SWITC: You chose me. I hope it was prudent.
Is it time to guard, or to strike?
Leave it to me. I hold this ground.
In your hand, the relics grow warm.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.ELITE: A strong evil. Do not charge in proudly.
Like a heathen champion. Roland would've met it smiling.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.BOSSS: A great evil. The relics tremble.
Fear not. Ten blows on a rock did not break me.
Today, hit that instead of a rock.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.BOSSV: A great evil has fallen. Glory to the Lord.
Not even the Song of Roland has a victory like this. It needs a new verse.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.FLAWL: Unharmed. Do not lose your humility.
Not a drop shed. A blessed fight.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.CURSE: Roland's Rock. Consider it a trial.
My fault. I'll bear that rock with you.
It fades after a few fights. Let's endure.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.RELEA: So I must go. God keep you.
Wherever I am, I'll pray for you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.REACQ: I have returned. The Lord's will, surely.
I stand beside you again. My prayers were answered.
Beware greed. That merchant's eyes are shifty.
Buy holy water if they have it. ...They don't.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.DURANDAL.EVENT: There is temptation here. Steel your heart.
Whatever you choose, I trust your conscience.
Are you praying? It's a long one.
Patience is a virtue. The enemy doesn't know that.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.SUMMO: Not a swordsman's hand. Nor a smith's.
A warden's.
Moye, stay close to me today.
I always am.
Here. I'll lend you this edge once more.
I'll use it well.
Ensifer, Moye was worried about you. So was I... a little.
Thanks, both of you.
Not just a little.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.COMBA: They have the look of the king's soldiers. I dislike it.
Like stoking a bellows—go hard from the start.
Hard from the start. Got it.
Moye, care to wager who cuts more today?
I'll fight as hot as the fire that forged us.
Hot is fine. Just don't burn me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.VICTO: Light work, compared to a king's neck.
Moye, check my edge for nicks.
It's fine. You worry too much.
They say a good blade needs a good hand.
This one handles a blade better than our own son.
Don't compare. They're both good boys.
Wet firewood. You've no eye for fire.
I'll find dry wood next time.
A smith can't lie before a fire. Nor can you.
Ensifer, someday I'd like to forge you a blade of your own.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.LOWHP: Your body will break before the blade does.
Steel hardens as it cools. But don't cool yet.
Moye gave herself to the furnace to protect something. You have things to protect too.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.UPGRA: Wrong hammer angle. ...The result is fine.
A fine quenching sound. Moye, did you hear?
Forging my wife and me together—you're a smith now.
Now we'd not envy even those who made us.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.SWITC: Open it. I'll watch the rear.
Fits right in your grip. Yours is a smith's hand now.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.ELITE: A big one. Good for testing steel.
Moye, that one looks hard. Let's go together.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.BOSSS: Bigger than the king. Still has a neck, I'd wager.
Ensifer, Moye—today we three are one.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.BOSSV: The biggest cut since the king's neck.
Must that always be the measure?
Three years to forge, one day to fell a giant. Moye, did you see?
I saw. The three of us did it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.FLAWL: Not a scratch. We blocked it all.
A flawless fight. Like good steel.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.CURSE: Furnace Offering. Steel always grows by swallowing something.
I'd rather it not swallow my health.
The price Moye paid has passed to you. I'm sorry.
It's fine. I can bear it.
We'll endure it. We're with you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.RELEA: Giving us up? Moye, let's go.
The fire isn't going out. Call and we'll come.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.REACQ: This tomb again? Well, not bad.
Those blades—terrible quench. Don't buy them.
Anything here for Moye? A trinket?
No thanks. Whatever you pick is always heavy.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.GANJIANG.EVENT: Suspicious place. Like the king's palace.
Tap it like steel before you choose.
If it rings clear, I take it?
Cooled steel is useless. Don't dawdle.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SUMMON.T0: Not so tight, please. It hurts.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SUMMON.T3: Just from your voice, I can tell if you're hurt.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.COMBATSTA: Don't rush. Using us both takes rhythm.
Ensifer, I'll watch the left. Ganjiang has the right.
Hm, leave the right to me.
Let's get home safe today. All three.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.VICTORY.T: When you smile, I'm happy too.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.REST.T0.1: The fire reminds me of the one who made us.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.REST.T1.1: Do you have a blanket? Nights get cold.
You really sound like a mom.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.REST.T2.1: Ganjiang's dozing. A sword, dozing—funny, right?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.REST.T3.1: You made it through today. I'm so proud.
You're bleeding! Get behind me, quick.
Let us take the wounds. You just stay alive.
Don't say that. We all live.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.UPGRADE.T: That was a little scary. But it didn't hurt.
Don't I shine a little more than Ganjiang?
Your hands have grown gentle. They shook at first.
With this edge, I'll guard you for a long, long time.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SWITCH.T0: Me instead of Ganjiang? He'll sulk.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SWITCH.T2: Time to guard. Leave it to me.
Your hands are warm. I like that.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.ELITESTAR: That one's dangerous. Don't overdo it.
A strong foe. But three of us is enough.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.BOSSSTART: Something that big... Ganjiang, stay by me.
Ensifer, it's okay to say you're scared.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.BOSSVICTO: We did it... we really did.
Is everyone safe? Ganjiang, Ensifer... thank goodness.
Not a single scratch! You did so well today.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.CURSED.T0: That's... a memory of the furnace. I'm sorry.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.CURSED.T2: I know that heat best. Don't hold it long.
Got it. I'll put it down fast.
Must we go? Thank you for everything.
Eat properly. Don't skip meals without us.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.REACQUIRE: We're back. Have you been eating?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SHOP.T0.0: It's pricey. Only what you need.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.SHOP.T2.0: Don't they sell food? You're too thin.
Never thought a sword would say that.
Choose with your heart. We'll back you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.IDLE.T0.0: Are you all right? You're hesitating a lot.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.MOYE.IDLE.T2.0: Take your time. Just not too long.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.SUMMO: You grasp a sacred treasure with unclean hands. Go wash.
No time.
The clouds part, for I have come.
Quite the entrance.
Ensifer, read the wind. I'll clear the way.
You read it for me.
At your call, even the clouds of heaven descend.
The clouds can stay up there.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.COMBA: Trifles, next to the eight-headed serpent.
Lightly, like cutting grass. Ease your grip.
The clouds hang low. That favors us.
Friend, the heavens are with you again.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.VICTO: The impurity is cleansed. Your swordwork is still clumsy.
I hear he was stingy with praise.
Today's wind was clear. Like your heart.
I never thought a sacred treasure would thank a mortal. Thank you.
No clouds tonight. My power wanes on such nights.
Yamato Takeru often slept in fields like this.
Was he afraid of fire too?
Your breathing is even. A good night.
Warmer than when I was enshrined.
It's much smaller than a shrine.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.LOWHP: The impurity is thick. Even I can't help like this.
When wildfire spreads, set a counterfire. Hold your ground.
Catch your breath. The wind turns your way again.
What use are two if I lose you? Rise, my friend.
I'm up. We still have one left.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.UPGRA: Clumsy. But your heart is clean.
The cloud pattern returns to my blade.
The gleam I had when drawn from Orochi's tail.
So that's how you first shone.
With this edge, I'll mow every weed on your path.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.SWITC: The power of the blade before me—I take it up.
The wind has shifted. My turn.
I won't waste the momentum the last blade left.
In your hand, the clouds gather.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.ELITE: That must be a whelp of Orochi.
Thick impurity. Worth one of my two.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.BOSSS: Nothing like this since the eight-headed serpent.
I'll call every cloud in the sky. Friend, let's go.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.BOSSV: A great impurity lifted. I'll praise you, just this once.
The sky is as clear as the day Susanoo slew Orochi.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.FLAWL: Not a speck of impurity on you. Not bad.
Victory without a scratch. Even the heavens are surprised.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.CURSE: Tenmu's Illness. Karma for mishandling a sacred treasure.
That illness was the punishment of a king who angered me. I'm sorry it reached you.
It's not yours to apologize for.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.RELEA: A sacred treasure chooses where it stays. Not here, it seems.
When the wind blows your way again, I'll return.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.REACQ: You enshrine me again. Be devout this time.
I've returned. The wind pointed to you.
Look for a mirror or a jewel. I miss my old companions.
The other treasures? Not here, I bet.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.KUSANAGI.EVENT: A strange aura. Don't touch anything carelessly.
With a clean heart, the way opens.
Even clouds move on. Why do you stand still?
Long thoughts. The wind won't wait.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.SUMMO: Has the sun set? Check before you draw.
All twelve woke at once. Bear the noise.
The thirteenth brother calls, and the twelve rise.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.COMBA: Pick out their graves in advance.
Reminds me of the day Böðvarr Bjarki fought as a bear.
I can't turn into a bear.
Just make the first wound. We'll grow the rest.
Brother, this will be easier than King Hrólf's last battle.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.VICTO: Passable. Four of the twelve say so.
The twelve want to raise their cups. We have none.
King Hrólf would have made you a berserker.
Never draw me in front of a woman. It's taboo. Did you know?
One of the twelve is singing. Say if it bothers you.
Rub a wound with the stone and it heals. Shall we try it on yours?
A short night beside you beats a long one in the barrow. All twelve agree.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.LOWHP: Fall bleeding and we'll take you to our barrow.
The twelve call your name. Hear them, Ensifer?
We will not lose the thirteenth. All twelve, raise your blades!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.UPGRA: Three of the twelve complain. The hammer's too heavy.
Like frost on my edge. Good.
The twelve are unanimously pleased. Rare.
With this edge, I'll carve wounds that never close on your foes.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.SWITC: Our turn? The twelve tighten their grips.
No sun? Good. Out we go.
The wounds have piled up. Time to reap.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.ELITE: A thick one. The twelve are licking their lips.
As strong as King Hrólf's foes. Brother, don't rush.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.BOSSS: One barrow won't be enough for that.
All twelve are standing. Like King Hrólf's last night.
This time the ending is different.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.BOSSV: It fell. For once the twelve agree: well done.
We could hold King Hrólf's feast again. You're the guest of honor.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.FLAWL: Not a scratch. Unbecoming of a berserker.
Gave wounds, took none. The twelve are impressed.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.CURSE: The Sköfnung Stone. A stone that heals wounds doesn't care whose.
The stone heals the wrong wounds. The twelve are ashamed.
It's fine. I'll set it down soon.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.RELEA: Just moving from one barrow to another.
Thirteenth brother, the twelve won't forget you.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.REACQ: Our brother called us back. The twelve rejoice.
Don't show me to the merchant. He'll try to price me.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.SKOFNUNG.EVENT: Strange place. Check for sunlight first.
The twelve are split. You decide.
Brother, deliberate too long and the twelve start arguing.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.COMBAT: I move first. Don't stop me.
Whatever targets you, I cut first.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.REST.T: Oni come at night. I don't sleep.
Then I'll stay up with you. A little.
From the sheath, I listen to you breathe. I like that.
Step back. The rest is my job.
Onimaru asking a favor. I won't fall.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.UPGRAD: My edge is clear. Like your heart.
For a long, long time, please.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.SWITCH: I'll cut it myself. You just watch.
In your hand, I needn't move on my own.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.ELITES: ......That's as good as an oni. I may cut it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.BOSSST: Ensifer. I leave my back to you. I'll open the front.
Right. Don't worry about your back.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.BOSSVI: Even the oni king falls. When you're here.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.CURSED: A masterless blade. That's what I am.
No master, maybe. But you have a comrade.
......I'm sorry. It's not that I don't accept you.
I know. That's just the curse.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.RELEAS: Back to cutting alone. ......A little sad.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.SHOP.T: That merchant isn't an oni. Relax.
Whatever you pick, if an oni appears, I cut it.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.ONIMARU.IDLE.T: ......I'm used to waiting. The enemy isn't.
Ta-da! The light is here. Applause?
...Clap, clap.
How's my shine today? I made an effort last night.
Blinding. Literally.
Ensifer! Where shall I shine today?
The darkest spot over there.
When you call, my light gets brighter. Really.
Then I'll call more often.
One look at me and they'll be blinded.
I might be too.
Let's be flashy, like a treasure of Findias should.
Flashy, but careful.
Hold me when the turn ends. You know.
Yeah. I remember the promise.
I'll shine for you again today. And dazzle the foes.
I like both.
Naturally. I was there.
So was I.
Score my light today?
A hundred.
Your swing plus my light—pure art.
Not sure about art, but it was good.
We won! Now it's polishing time.
Got it. Sparkly clean.
Don't compare this campfire to me. It's pitiful.
I won't.
Nuada got a silver arm and took back his throne. Cool, right?
You light up whenever you talk about him.
I'll glow just a little tonight. Easy on your eyes.
Thanks for the thought.
On starless nights, I'll be your star.
The brightest one.
Oh dear, you're a mess. Wasting my light.
I'll make it worth it.
Come toward the light. The dark is dangerous.
Okay. Toward you.
You can have all my light. You can't go out!
I won't. Still bright.
Ensifer, look at me. I'll shine my brightest—just look at me!
I'm looking. Always.
Ooh, shinier! Got a mirror?
Your blade is a mirror.
The light reaches my tip. I love this.
Glad to hear.
I wish Nuada could see me now.
I'll look instead.
All this light is yours. Use it however you like.
I'll use it sparingly.
My turn at last! Spotlight, please!
You are the spotlight.
Bored without me?
A little.
You'll hold me to the end this time, right?
That's the plan.
The light has come! Begone, darkness!
Nice entrance.
Big guy, big shadow. I'll erase it.
Please.
Tough one. I need to store light—hold me at turn's end.
Got it. Let's build it up.
Look at that darkness. I have to light all of it? Tiring.
You can, right?
I'm trembling like Nuada before Balor. But let's go together.
Together. I trust your light.
See? No one escapes my light.
This time, I'll grant you that.
Right now, we're the brightest thing in the world!
So bright I might tear up.
Not a scratch. Just like me.
You'd throw a fit over one.
A flawless, shining victory! Aren't we too perfect?
We are. Admitted.
Nuada's lost arm... don't bring it up.
So you have sore spots too.
Sorry. Even my light casts a shadow.
I'll take the shadow too.
Hmph, giving up a treasure like me? You'll regret it.
Probably.
Even gone, I'll keep shining your way.
...Thank you, Solais. Goodbye.
It was dark without me, wasn't it?
Very.
I'm back! Missed me? Me too!
Yeah, I missed you.
Do they sell polish? The best kind!
I doubt it.
That merchant's lamp is dimmer than me. Want to rent me out as a light?
Never.
So gloomy. Shall I light it up?
Just a bit.
Wherever you go, I'll light the way. Choose.
Then I'll pick with confidence.
Hello? I'm shining here, aren't you looking?
I am. Just thinking.
Your thinking face is cute, but let's move.
Okay, let's go.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.SUMM: Fresh air at last! Make room for my swing!
When you call, the hills tremble! Haha!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.COMB: I hope there's three or more! One sweep!
I'll swing wide as a rainbow—duck!
One or ten, with you it's all fun!
Better fighting with you than with Fergus! I mean it!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.VICT: Friend, your swing has rhythm now!
Let out a victory roar! Waaah!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.REST: This fire's too small. Should be big enough to burn a hill.
Ulster's warriors held boasting contests by the fire. Try it!
I have nothing to boast about.
Shall I tell you of the Cattle Raid of Cooley? It's very long!
Friend, tonight I'll watch the fire quietly too. ...For a bit.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.LOWH: Hey! Tired already? There's swinging left to do!
Behind me! A big blade makes a shield too!
They dare touch my friend?! I'll sweep them all!
Laugh, friend! We've never lost while laughing!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.UPGR: Only as much as fits in the tomb.
Not even Lethe's blade was this good!
I still don't know who Lethe is.
This weight, this edge! Friend, your hammering is the best!
Now I could cleave three mountains, not just hills!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.SWIT: My turn?! Everyone out of the way!
Haha! You needed the big blade after all?
Friend, I'll sweep them all in one go!
I feel light in your hands! No—you got stronger!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.ELIT: A hefty one! I like it!
One big one. Fine—I'll cut just as big!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.BOSS: Hahaha! It's the size of a hill! Finally, a foe my size!
Friend, this is bigger than the Cattle Raid. Let's make our names!
Names or not, let's survive together.
It's down! Hill number four! Hahaha!
This fight deserves a song! The Song of Ensifer and Caladbolg!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.FLAW: Not a scratch! I swung so big nobody got close!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.CURS: The Shield of the Unstruck King... don't ask about that day.
The price of sparing that king reached even you. Sorry, friend.
It's fine. You did the right thing.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.RELE: What? Me? ...Fine, a big blade is welcome anywhere!
Friend, see me off with a smile. I'll come back loud!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.REAC: Haha! I'm back! The tomb got cramped!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.SHOP: Any big sheaths? These are all tiny!
Merchant! Your biggest item! ...My friend pays!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.EVEN: Hope whatever's here can be cut!
Friend, when in doubt, go big! Keep regrets small!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.CALADBOLG.IDLE: Hey! If you don't swing, I'll rust!
Friend, you can think while swinging!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.BANTER.GRAM_TY: The hero's blade, still lying around broken.
The cursed blade, still showing off its golden hilt.
Both of you, stop. The enemy's over there.
Tyrfing. If your curse touches Ensifer, I cut you first.
Try it. With a broken blade.
If you want a fight, fight them.
Gram, you slew a dragon. I slew kings.
Is that something to boast of?
Today, let's both do something worth boasting about.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.BANTER.DURANDA: Durandal! Let's bet who cuts more!
Dainsleif, even a bloodthirsty blade can repent.
If I repent, do I get blood?
Listen to him. He's not wrong.
I sense a curse. The relics sting.
A saint's tooth. Afraid of my curse?
Unbreakable, are you? I never rust. We're alike.
I endure by faith. What do you endure by?
Tyrfing, I will pray for you as well.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.BANTER.KUSANAG: Onimaru, you too were a blade of our land.
Treasure. Have you ever cut an oni?
Don't you miss the cherry blossoms of home?
......I don't cut flowers. That's why I like them.
Let's go somewhere with flowers someday.
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.BANTER.CALADBO: Solais! Two blades of Ériu meet!
Lower your voice. My light's flickering.
You're all size and no sparkle.
And you're all sparkle and tiny!
You're both great in your own way.
King Nuada's blade! Fergus spoke of you!
That you were too bright to look at!
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.BANTER.SKOFNUN: Sigurd's blade. Five of the twelve know you.
They say they don't know any broken blade.
The twelve are whispering. Ignore them.
Sköfnung, when all twelve talk at once, Ensifer gets confused.
So today only six will talk.
There's twelve of you? So you drink twelve times the blood?
We don't drink blood. We only leave wounds.
(the twelve whisper) Högni's blade... the endless battle...
Today's fight will end. Both of you, remember that.
Two blades of the north meet. You're too loud.
Says the one with twelve voices?
MAGICSWORDSMAN-SWORD_TALK.BANTER.COUPLE_: Dainsleif, you'll get hurt if you're so excited.
Swords chip too. I know it well.
That one's like our son as a boy.
Am I being teased right now?
You two always stick together? Don't you get sick of it?
Not even after a thousand years.
A blade that moves on its own. Which smith made you?
Ensifer does. Keep an eye on him.
You two are so close you're blocking my light.
Oh, sorry. Shall we move apart?
Sparkling while cutting is my specialty, you know?
Stop it, both of you. You're troubling Ensifer.
Gram, how good was Regin, who forged you?
Good enough to split an anvil.
Gram, you've been with Ensifer the longest, right? Look after him.
Must be nice, traveling as two. I was always alone.
